archive_freeze_readback: Original frozen rankings reproduced byte for byte on 211 prior races. New private inputs and rankings were separately read back and hash-checked before any target deadline.
comparison: Frozen incumbent B-to-corner/corner-to-finish (20,22 training observations) against updated (27,30) on the same 60 race inputs. Baseline and updated rankings agree by construction for the eight individual-position races.
coverage: All 60 unique IDs in the already saved pre-deadline feed for this date. The source does not certify the national race universe.
scoring_rule: Evaluate the top 1, 4 and 8 as exact three-place ordered tickets against official paid trifecta orders. An eligible race is a hit if any listed order is in the authoritative settlement. Track cancellations, unavailable records and unresolved results separately; show each denominator. Use every forecast, including races on which the two models agree.
